The bonfire, five candidates

Drawn 27 August 2026, after the shipped mark was rendered at its delivered size and turned out to be a gold leaf on a stem. Every drawing here uses the same pen (src/utils/nib.ts) and the same 96-unit box the component ships. At 24px one pixel is four units of that box, which is the number every failure below comes back to: a gap under four units closes, a body under four units greys out, and a taper that ends below two units ends in nothing.

The large view is the 24px raster enlarged with smoothing off — not the vector redrawn. A mark judged at the size it was drawn is not judged at all.

— What shipped until today

Three tongues with three units of ground between them, and tapers running over half of every stroke. At 24px one pixel is four units: the slivers close, the blade's point arrives at 0.7 units, and the guard is narrower than the fire above it. Delivered, it is a gold leaf on a stem.

A Weight

The same drawing, floored at 8 units of body and 4 of taper, gaps opened to 7. Everything survives except the third tongue, which the rasteriser merges into the tall one — it costs mass and buys nothing.

B Two tongues

Three tongues means two slivers, and two slivers is one more than the eye holds here. One gap, 8 units wide, and the tongues share a base so the fire is one fire. Chosen — it is the only candidate that fixes the failure without changing what the mark depicts.

C Sword-led

Hierarchy inverted: the sword is the mark and the fire a crown on it. Legible, but it changes what the mark is about — and a long vertical with a bar across it spends its whole budget on not being a cross.

D Silhouette

One closed mass with a bite out of the front. The bite is eight units at its mouth and still closes: a concave notch has an inside, and at two pixels deep the inside is one pixel. It delivers as a blob on a stick.

E Ash and fire

The sword dropped, the mound drawn as mass. The clearest fire of the six and the least like a bonfire — without the sword it is a campfire, and the mark loses the thing it was named for.

✔ As it ships

B, with three corrections made after it won and none of them visible in the source: the two tongues were brought together at the foot, so the fire is one fire that forks rather than two prongs on a stand; the guard was widened past the flame and dropped six units clear of it, because an arm that ends inside the fire's own width is not a crossguard and two marks less than a pixel apart are one mark; and the guard's arms were made unequal in length and in drop, because a blade under a level bar of equal arms is a cross.
